title: Zesty Crisp Saudi Arabian Lentil Wrap
description: A funky and quick-fix Saudi Arabian dish featuring salt and al-dente lentils, wrapped in a crisp corn husk wrap, perfect for a flexitarian diet. This dish is a great option for a snack or lunch.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and soak them in water for 30 minutes.
Drain and rinse the lentils, then transfer them to a pot with 2 cups of water and 1 teaspoon of salt.
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the lentils are al-dente.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and saute the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the cumin and paprika to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir the cooked lentils into the pan and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Warm the corn husk wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Spoon the lentil mixture onto the center of each corn husk wrap and fold the wrap to enclose.
Serve the wraps immediately and enjoy.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
